name: Gladiatorial Alumnus
body:
You trained at an exclusive gladiatorial college.

Select one combat maneuver when you take this trait.

Benefit(s) You gain a +1 trait bonus on performance combat checks and a +1 trait bonus on combat maneuver checks to perform the selected maneuver.
